bearingDegrees.title: Bearingdegrees
bearingDegrees.description: Direction the vehicle travels as it leaves the boarding stop, degrees clockwise from north (0-360); null when neither the leg's path nor its next stop gives one.

bearingSource.title: Bearingsource
bearingSource.description: `leg_geometry`: read over the first 30 m of the leg's path after the stop. `stop_sequence`: straight towards the next stop (no path).

stopSide.title: Stopside
stopSide.description: Which side of the vehicle's path the stop stands on, facing the direction of travel. A person is on the stop's side of the road when they are on this side of the line through `pathPoint` at `bearingDegrees`. Null with `stopSideUnavailableReason` when it cannot be told from the data.

stopOffsetMeters.title: Stopoffsetmeters
stopOffsetMeters.description: Distance from the stop to the nearest point of the vehicle's path.

pathPoint.title: Pathpoint
pathPoint.description: [longitude, latitude] of the vehicle path's point nearest the stop.

towards.title: Towards
towards.description: The trip's headsign (where the vehicle is signed to).

nextStop.description: The first stop after boarding (the alighting stop on a one-stop ride).

stopCount.title: Stopcount
stopCount.description: Stops travelled until alighting, counting the alighting stop; null when the engine's intermediate stops are unreadable.

Boarding.title: Boarding
Boarding.description: Where to wait for a transit leg (board 3: "on this side, toward <place>").

stopId.title: Stopid
stopId.description: The platform or stop the vehicle leaves from.

operatorId.title: Operatorid
operatorId.description: GTFS agency ID (API-C3); null when the engine omits it.

operatorName.title: Operatorname
operatorName.description: Operator name as in the feed (API-C3).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: The same mode strings journey legs use (`bus`, `rail`, `light_rail`; rarer engine modes as `cable_car`, `funicular`, `ferry`, else `other`); null when the engine omits it.

directionId.title: Directionid
directionId.description: GTFS direction_id of the trip, if any.

walkingDistanceMeters.title: Walkingdistancemeters
walkingDistanceMeters.description: Sum of walk-leg distances; null when any walk leg's distance is unknown, such as a transfer whose street path is unavailable (TRANSFER_STREET_PATH_UNAVAILABLE).

departAt.title: Departat
departAt.description: ISO timestamp with an explicit offset. Exactly one of departAt/arriveBy.

arriveBy.title: Arriveby
arriveBy.description: ISO timestamp with an explicit offset. Exactly one of departAt/arriveBy.

modes.title: Modes
modes.description: Unique transit modes the engine may use. Walking is always allowed.

maxAccessWalkMinutes.title: Maxaccesswalkminutes
maxAccessWalkMinutes.description: Cap on the first walk before boarding, in whole minutes (1-30). Sent to the engine as maxPreTransitTime. Does not bound walking between transit legs.

maxEgressWalkMinutes.title: Maxegresswalkminutes
maxEgressWalkMinutes.description: Cap on the last walk after alighting, in whole minutes (1-30). Sent to the engine as maxPostTransitTime. Does not bound walking between transit legs.

excludeTripRefs.title: Excludetriprefs
excludeTripRefs.description: Dated trip references (a leg's `transit.engineTripId`) no returned journey may ride, for example the bus that did not come. Alternatives using one are omitted (warning `EXCLUDED_TRIP_ALTERNATIVES_OMITTED`); the engine is asked for its maximum number of alternatives so that others can take their place.

maxDirectWalkMinutes.title: Maxdirectwalkminutes
maxDirectWalkMinutes.description: Cap on a walk-only alternative, in whole minutes (1-30). Sent to the engine as maxDirectTime.

intermediateStops.title: Intermediatestops
intermediateStops.description: Stops passed between boarding and alighting, in order; null for a walk.

boarding.description: Where and which way to board; null for a walk.

routeId.title: Routeid
routeId.description: The route this pattern belongs to. A MOT route is one direction, so with `patterns=all` the line's other directions (same operator and line code) appear here under their own route IDs, with `servesStop` false unless they also stop here.

servesStop.title: Servesstop
servesStop.description: True when the tapped stop or one of its platforms is on it.

stopIndex.title: Stopindex
stopIndex.description: Index in `stops` of the first call at the tapped stop (or its platform); the line fans out from here in its direction of travel. Null when not served.

geometrySource.title: Geometrysource
geometrySource.description: `stops` is the ordered stop sequence, not the street path. For the street path of one trip use `GET /v1/trips/{tripRef}` (`shape`).

platformCode.title: Platformcode
platformCode.description: Platform or bay at a transit stop, from the generation's reference (API-C2); null when the feed gives none.

appliedConstraints.title: Appliedconstraints
appliedConstraints.description: Constraints the adapter sent to the engine, plus disclosures. transferWalkLimit is always not_enforced: walking between transit legs is unbounded and totalled per journey in walkingSeconds. engineWalkCapConformance states whether the engine's enforcement of the caps has been verified.

unavailableReason.title: Unavailablereason
unavailableReason.description: Problem code when this stop's departures could not be read.

complete.title: Complete
complete.description: False when the per-stop lookup bound stopped before `perStop` lines were found, or the stop is unavailable. True means every line departing in the window was considered.

departures.title: Departures
departures.description: Earliest departure of each line (route and headsign), in time order, at most `perStop`; null when unavailable. An empty list means no boardable departure in the window.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: The same mode strings journey legs use (`bus`, `rail`, `light_rail`; rarer engine modes as `cable_car`, `funicular`, `ferry`, else `other`); null when the engine omits it. Derived from the GTFS route_type.

distanceMeters.title: Distancemeters
distanceMeters.description: From `near`; for a station, the distance to its nearest platform.

Stopover.title: Stopover
Stopover.description: A stop a transit leg passes between boarding and alighting.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: The same mode strings journey legs use (`bus`, `rail`, `light_rail`; rarer engine modes as `cable_car`, `funicular`, `ferry`, else `other`); null when the engine omits it.

shape.description: The whole trip's path, first to last stop.
